scope: Executable conditional interface. The community GRH proof is passed as a theorem hypothesis. No verification of that proof, the finite assemblies or Goldbach export is claimed here.

module

public import Statements
public import TernaryGoldbach.Statement

public section

namespace GoldbachInterfaceCheck

theorem plattGRH_of_primitive (grh : PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine) :
    TernaryGoldbach.PlattGRH := by
  intro q _ χ hχ
  constructor <;> intro _ _ ρ hz h₀ h₁ _ <;> exact grh q χ hχ ρ h₀ h₁ hz

example : TernaryGoldbach.PlattGRH =
    (∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q), χ.IsPrimitive →
      (Odd q → q ≤ 300000 → ∀ ρ : ℂ, χ.LFunction ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 →
        |ρ.im| ≤ 100000000 / q → ρ.re = 1 / 2) ∧
      (Even q → q ≤ 400000 → ∀ ρ : ℂ, χ.LFunction ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 →
        |ρ.im| ≤ max ((100000000 : ℝ) / q) (200 + 75000000 / q) → ρ.re = 1 / 2)) := by
  have first : (1e8 : ℝ) = 100000000 := by norm_num
  have second : (7.5e7 : ℝ) = 75000000 := by norm_num
  unfold TernaryGoldbach.PlattGRH
  rw [first, second]

example : PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine =
    (∀ (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d), χ.IsPrimitive →
      ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → χ.LFunction s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2) := rfl

example (grh : PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine) : Fact TernaryGoldbach.PlattGRH :=
  ⟨plattGRH_of_primitive grh⟩

#print axioms plattGRH_of_primitive

end GoldbachInterfaceCheck
